annotations.title: Add an AI chat button to a website

description: Get the one-line code that puts a fone.me AI agent on a website: a chat button in the corner where visitors chat, call by voice, or continue on WhatsApp or Telegram, and the agent answers questions, takes messages and booking requests for the owner. Use it when someone building or editing a website (HTML, Next.js, React, WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer) wants a chatbot, AI receptionist, live chat or contact widget. Free to start. Give the person's fone.me link if they have one.

link.description: The site owner's fone.me link, e.g. 'fone.me/joes-plumbing' or 'joes-plumbing'. Leave out if they don't have one yet.

site.description: What the site is built with: html, nextjs, react, wordpress, shopify, wix, squarespace, webflow, framer. Default html.
